assay: bulk RNA-seq (rRNA-depleted, NovaSeq 6000) of subcutaneous CT-26 tumor tissue
sample_inclusion: 6 tumors per group randomly selected from 10 control and 10 swimming male BALB/c mice (S2.6.p1, S2.4.p1)
primary_estimand: Effect of 3 weeks of swimming (twice daily, 6 d/week, up to 30 min) on tumor-tissue gene expression in CT-26 tumor-bearing mice, swimming vs control (S2.5.p1, S3.2.p1)
planned_contrasts: swimming vs control (S3.2.p1; paper: 715 up / 629 down transcripts = 1344 DETs)
repeated_measure_unit: none; one tumor per independent mouse
paper_method: limma on StringTie transcript-level expression (S2.6.p1); KEGG ORA on DETs (S3.3.p1)
paper_results: 715 up / 629 down transcripts; Vegfa mRNA down; Stat3, Pdgfa, Pld2, Pik3r2 decreased; Hif1a and Kdr (VEGFR2) mRNA unchanged (S3.2.p1, S3.4.p1, S4.p4)
